brand_voice_note: Proud local butcher voice: warm, honest, and confident about ethically raised meat from Sunshine Coast farms, with none of the supermarket gloss.

concepts.primary_text:
Fire up the grill this weekend. 🔥

Four hand-formed Angus patties, roughly 150g each, made from beef with natural marbling that keeps every burger juicy off the grill or pan.

Free-range, ethically raised, hormone and antibiotic-free. Butcher selected, packed fresh and delivered cold to your door on the Sunshine Coast.
concepts.headline: Weekend Burgers, Sorted
concepts.why_it_works: Burgers are an occasion buy tied to backyard grilling, so anchoring the ad to the weekend cook-up matches exactly when this audience reaches for a pack.
concepts.visual_direction: A stack of four raw Angus patties on a butcher-block board with a glowing charcoal grill and drifting smoke behind.

concepts.product_title: FREE RANGE LEG HAM SLICED - natural nitrite
concepts.primary_text:
Clean-label ham that actually tastes like the real thing.

Our free-range leg ham is cured and smoked using naturally derived nitrites from celery, so you get traditional smoky flavour without the mystery ingredients.

Free-range and ethically raised, butcher-sliced and delivered cold. Perfect for sandwiches, boards, or a quick lunch that feels a bit special.
concepts.headline: Free-Range Ham, Clean Label
concepts.why_it_works: The single most desirable outcome here is traditional ham flavour without the chemical additives, so leading with that clean-label benefit speaks straight to the wellness-minded shopper.
concepts.visual_direction: Soft folded ham slices fanned on a dark metal tray with microgreens and a carving knife alongside.

concepts.primary_text:
A proper bone broth starts with proper bones.

These split lamb marrow bones are packed with creamy, nutrient-dense marrow that slow-braises down into rich, deep flavour, no stock cube required.

Sourced from local farms who share our passion for quality and animal welfare, packed fresh and delivered cold. Free delivery on orders over $200.
concepts.headline: Real Marrow, Real Broth
concepts.why_it_works: Home cooks chasing a rich broth struggle to find proper marrow bones at the supermarket, so naming that friction and offering the fix positions this humble cut as the missing ingredient.
concepts.visual_direction: Two split raw lamb marrow bones lying in a black cast-iron pot on dark stone with thyme and onions nearby.
